findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "kabbalah" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_kabbalah_daily · Public sink: post_kabbalah_gematria, post_kabbalah_name_profile, post_kabbalah_birth_profile, post_kabbalah_compatibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_kabbalah_daily · Public sink: post_kabbalah_gematria, post_kabbalah_name_profile, post_kabbalah_birth_profile, post_kabbalah_compatibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
